title: Precedent: decisions
summary: Which calls need you, and where they go afterwards. What each does, and what we'd borrow (the cards that borrow it are in brackets).

checks.text: Amazon's doors: One-way doors get care; two-way doors should be fast. Rust's final comment period works the same way. We borrow: going ahead unless you object (Calls I'm sure of go ahead unles…)
Architecture decision records: A short record of what was decided, why, and what it commits to. We borrow: decided cards become the Record (Decided cards: take them off, or…)

why: These are how other teams decide what needs a person and what can go ahead. They match what the board already does by habit: obvious calls get no card, and decided ones get recorded.
